p.src: 1  A revelation. The LORD’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward the LORD—

ja: み、 ダマスコの上にとどまる。
も、 イスラエルのすべての
en: A revelation. The LORD’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward the LORD—
u.src: 1  A revelation. The LORD’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward the LORD—

p.src: 2  and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.

ja: に富むツロとシドンにも
en: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.
u.src: 2  and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.

p.src: 3  Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

en: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.
u.src: 3  Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

p.src: 4  Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.

ja: の所有を奪い、 その
en: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.
u.src: 4  Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.

p.src: 5  Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.

ja: アシュケロンはそれを
しむ。 エクロンも、その
られるので苦しむ。 王はガザから

u.src: 5  Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.

p.src: 6  Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

en: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
u.src: 6  Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

p.src: 7  I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

ja: のために残りの者となり、 ユダの
のようになり、 エクロンはエブス
en: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
u.src: 7  I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

p.src: 8  I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.

ja: を敷き、 敵の軍勢が二度と行き来できないようにする。
en: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.
u.src: 8  I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.

p.src: 9  Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

ja: られる。 この方は義なる方で、
いを携え、 へりくだって、ろばに
っている。 しかも、ろばの
en: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
u.src: 9  Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

p.src: 10  I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

ja: を、 エルサレムから
en: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
u.src: 10  I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

p.src: 11  As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.

ja: また、あなたについては、 あなたの
のゆえに、 私は水のない穴から、あなたの
en: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.
u.src: 11  As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.

p.src: 12  Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

ja: のものを返すと告げる。
en: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.
u.src: 12  Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

p.src: 13  For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.

につがえた。 シオンよ、私はあなたの

u.src: 13  For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.

p.src: 14  The LORD will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.

en: The LORD will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.
u.src: 14  The LORD will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.

p.src: 15  The LORD of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.

en: The LORD of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.

p.src: 16  The LORD their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.

en: The LORD their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.
